content.title: Chapter 62 - OFFENSES — Sec. 62-58. - False reporting.
content.summary:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for any person intentionally, knowingly or recklessly to give
               false or misleading information, or make any false statement, or display false identification
               to any peace officer or other employee of the city who is acting in his official capacity…

faqs.a:
(a)
It shall be unlawful for any person intentionally, knowingly or recklessly to give
               false or misleading information, or make any false statement, or display false identification
               to any peace officer or other employee of the city who is acting in his official capacity
               and within the scope of his employment.
(b)
False reporting shall be punishable by a fine not to exceed the limits established
               in
section 1-5
.
(Code 1981, § 21-28; Ord. No. 2187, § 1, 8-5-1985; Ord. No. 2297, § 18, 5-5-1986)
State Law reference—
False reporting to authorities, C.R.S. § 18-8-111.
